Whey protein prices in India are increasing rapidly, and many fitness enthusiasts, students, and gym-goers are struggling to afford their daily protein intake.
But does that mean your muscle-building journey has to stop? Absolutely not.
In this video, I break down:
• Why whey protein has become so expensive
• The real problem in the supplement market
• Smart and affordable protein alternatives
This video is specially for:
Students
